newsitem.title: USA: Magainin Phase III Cytolex trial succeeds.
newsitem.headline: Magainin Phase III Cytolex trial succeeds.

text.p: Magainin Pharmaceuticals Inc said on Tuesday that its second, pivotal Phase III clinical trial of Cytolex one percent topical antibiotic cream (MSI-78) for the treatment of infection in diabetic foot ulcers was successful.
The company said its study showed statistical equivalence between MSI-78 and orally administered ofloxacin, manufactured by Johnson & Johnson, with respect to clinical response of infection.
According to Magainin, preliminary analyses of adverse events in the study suggest a favorable profile for MSI-78.

The company said that both drugs were well tolerated, but that treatment with ofloxacin was associated with a "significant excess" of problems related to the central nervous system, and insomnia in particular.
Magainin said it had successful results of its initial, pivotal trial of MSI-78 for the treatment of infection in diabetic foot ulcers in September 1996.
In February 1997, Magainin and SmithKline Beecham Plc entered into a development, supply and distribution agreement in which SmithKoine will market and sell MSI-78 in North America.
